title: Android 16 API 36 Target Alignment & Release Signing
releaseNotes: Android 16 API 36 Upgrade: Updated target and compile SDK to API 36 in accordance with Google Play security and platform requirements.
Production Release Signing: Configured cryptographically validated release signing certificate for Google Play Console distribution.
Platform Optimization: Maintained complete backwards compatibility for existing Davao student timetables and offline transit maps.
